summary: Notice for Spring 2027 new student recruitment for Master's, Ph.D., and Integrated programs at Inha University Graduate School of Manufacturing Innovation (제조혁신전문대학원).
Admission information sessions: 1st session on November 26, 2026 (Thu) 14:00 (Yonghyeon Campus 60th Anniversary Hall Rm 508), 2nd session on November 30, 2026 (Mon) 14:00 (Aerospace Campus Rm 204).
Information session application: Register via Google Forms.
Detailed recruitment guidelines can be checked on the graduate school website link.
en.easyExplanation: Inha University Graduate School of Manufacturing Innovation (제조혁신전문대학원) is recruiting new students for Spring 2027 Master's, Ph.D., and Integrated programs.
